title: John F. Kennedy: 'Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You'
summary: Ask not what your country can do for you — ask what you can do for your country.
keywords: John F. Kennedy: 'Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You'
full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring John F. Kennedy.

"Ask not what your country can do for you — ask what you can do for your country."

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
